arxiv-2411-10904.creator: John M. Neuberger, Nándor Sieben, James W. Swift
arxiv-2411-10904.description: Abstract . In a polydiagonal subspace of the Euclidean space, certain components of the vectors are equal (synchrony) or opposite (anti-synchrony). Polydiagonal subspaces invariant under a matrix have many applications in graph theory and dynamical systems, especially coupled cell networks. We describe invariant polydiagonal subspaces in terms of coloring vectors.

arxiv-2502-10596.title: Post-training an LLM for RAG? Train on Self-Generated Demonstrations
arxiv-2502-10596.creator: Matthew Finlayson, Ilia Kulikov, Daniel M. Bikel, Barlas Oguz, Xilun Chen, Aasish Pappu, Meta, Inc, aasish@meta.com
arxiv-2502-10596.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) often struggle with knowledge intensive NLP tasks, such as answering “Who won the latest World Cup?” because the knowledge they learn during training may be insufficient or outdated. Conditioning generation on retrieved documents—a technique known as retrieval augmented generation (RAG)—mitigates these shortcomings by allowing the model to leverage in-context information.

arxiv-2505-13077.title: Advancing Sequential Numerical Prediction in Autoregressive Models
arxiv-2505-13077.creator: Xiang Fei Jinghui Lu Qi Sun Hao Feng Yanjie Wang, Wei Shi An-lan Wang Jingqun Tang Can Huang
arxiv-2505-13077.description: Abstract Autoregressive models have become the de facto choice for sequence generation tasks, but standard approaches treat digits as independent tokens and apply cross-entropy loss, overlooking the coherent structure of numerical sequences. This paper introduces N umerical T oken I ntegrity Loss (NTIL) to address this gap.

pmc-11399563.title: The role of deubiquitinase USP2 in driving bladder cancer progression by stabilizing EZH2 to epigenetically silence SOX1 expression
pmc-11399563.creator: Fanghua Xu, Xiangda Xu, Huanhuan Deng, Zhaojun Yu, Jianbiao Huang, Leihong Deng, Haichao Chao
pmc-11399563.description: Highlights•Aberrantly highly expressed USP2 in bladder cancer tissues and cells negatively correlates with the survival of bladder cancer patients.•USP2 silencing weakens the capacities of cell growth, migration and invasion in vitro.•USP2 interacts with and stabilizes EZH2 by inhibiting its ubiquitination.•USP2-mediated EZH2 stabilization promotes epigenetic suppression on SOX1.•USP2-EZH2-SOX1 axis enhances bladder cancer tumor growth in vivo.

pmc-11519136.title: Incidence and Pattern of Recurrence after Surgical Resection in Organ-Confined Renal Cell Carcinoma
pmc-11519136.creator: Jongchan Kim, Won Sik Ham, Jee Soo Park, Won Sik Jang
pmc-11519136.description: PurposeTo evaluate the incidence and pattern of recurrence after surgery in patients with organ-confined renal cell carcinoma (RCC) to establish an appropriate follow-up plan.Materials and MethodsIn this retrospective study, we evaluated data from 2960 patients who underwent radical or partial nephrectomy for stage 1 or 2 RCC.

pmc-11528437.title: Plasmonic Hinge Modes in Metal-Coated Nanolasers
pmc-11528437.creator: Sangyeon Cho, Yi Yang, Marin Soljačić, Seok Hyun Yun
pmc-11528437.description: Plasmonic lasers have traditionally been built on flat metal substrates. Here, we introduce substrate-free plasmonic lasers created by coating semiconductor particles with an optically thin layer of noble metal. This architecture supports plasmonic “hinge” modes highly localized along the particle’s edges and corners, exhibiting Purcell factors exceeding 100 and Q-factors of 15–20 near the plasmon resonance frequency.

pmc-11638446.title: Exploring the cross-sectional association between the strength of school vaping policies and student vaping behaviours using data from the 2021–2022 COMPASS Study
pmc-11638446.creator: Erin Kostuch, Richard Bélanger, Scott T Leatherdale, Adam G Cole
pmc-11638446.description: ObjectivesYouth vaping is a concern in Canada. While school-level policies influence student behaviours, few studies have investigated the association between school vaping policies and student vaping. This study reviewed and scored the comprehensiveness of school vaping policies and investigated the association between school vaping policy scores and student vaping.

pmc-11642627.title: Influence of Inflammation on Red Blood Cell Lifespan in Peritoneal Dialysis Patients
pmc-11642627.creator: Huiping Zhao, Yuchao Zhao, Bei Wu, Li Bai, Lixia Lu, Li Zuo
pmc-11642627.description: Background and hypothesis: Renal anemia is linked to a decreased lifespan of red blood cells. The factors influencing red blood cell lifespan (RBCLS) in peritoneal dialysis patients, particularly the connection between inflammation and RBCLS, are still not well understood. This cross-sectional study was conducted to investigate these relationships.

pmc-11691546.title: OLDER ADULTS REPORTING FEAR OF FALLING PRESENT WITH REDUCED PHYSICAL FUNCTION
pmc-11691546.creator: Emerson Sebastiao, Vitor Siqueira, Jemimah Bakare
pmc-11691546.description: Falls pose a significant risk to older adults (OAs), often leading to fear of falling (FOF). This study investigated the prevalence and the impact of FOF on physical activity (PA), sedentary behavior (SB), and physical function in OAs living in a community-dwelling facility (CDF). Ninety-three OAs were included in the study.

uslaw-usc-t46-s3716.title: 46 U.S.C. § 3716 — Tank washings
uslaw-usc-t46-s3716.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s3716.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part B (Inspection And Regulation Of Vessels); Chapter 37 (Carriage Of Liquid Bulk Dangerous Cargoes). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) A vessel may not transfer cargo in a port or place subject to the jurisdiction of the United States if, before arriving, the vessel has discharged tank washings containing oil or hazardous material in preparation.
